description: Does the camera enter the radar's ACC target (0x235 / 0x237)? The camera's object channel to the radar is not on the logged bus, and the camera-sent bus-1 frames never drop out (longest gap 0.78 s in 698 one-minute segments), so the natural experiment is the object-list slot's camera-association state 112|3 (docs/03), which by day ends between 40 and 60 m. 698 owner segments, 393k ACC-target cycles, day plus 4 night routes; ACC target matched to a mature object-list track (age >= 60) by position; ego > 8 m/s. Exploratory.

steps_at_association_onset_and_loss.note: [mean, standard error]; the ACC step does not lean toward the vision lead's offset (distance weight 0.000 +- 0.020 at onset, placebo 0.006)

conditional_association_onset_slope_limi.scope: Approximate estimator-specific limits on an association-linked response toward the logged vision offset, not total camera weights.
required_assumptions: association state switches the relevant input on/off
logged vision offset represents factory camera offset

within_0_25_s_after_association_onset.scope: Timing coincidence; excess pair rate is not an attributable causal acquisition fraction.

reading: No distinct association-linked kinematic response under the tested estimators; general factory-camera contribution is unqualified. Target selection agrees with listed radar objects, with enriched association-onset timing at 40-50 m compatible with shared triggers or camera-assisted selection.
